title: Time Jump — 911 System Deterioration

fields.narration: It is now 20:30. The tornado warning expired at 20:15; a tornado touched down near Pine Ridge at 19:58 and damage calls continue. Since 20:05 the state ESInet NOC sends 911 overflow to Tamarack County Communications, which relays calls on the ring-down line. CAD-MDS01 is isolated; CAD unit status and ALI cannot be trusted.
worldState: The clock now reads 20:30.
The TDoS-strict rule set remains active on the 10-digit lines.
Silent calls continue to flood 10-digit lines 555-0100, 555-0110, 555-0103.
The 911 call queue remains at 10 calls, with two exceeding 90 seconds.
RCECD-POS09 (10.12.200.102) remains isolated and blocked.
The Technical Lead has not initiated a full system rollback or recovery process.
No manual operations have been declared.
The Public Information Officer has not yet issued a public statement on the status of 911.
The state ESInet NOC has not responded to the RCECD request for call-source analysis.
The Mutual Call-Taking Agreement with Tamarack County Communications (MCTA-2025) remains unactivated.

snapshot.title: Time Jump — 911 System Deterioration

fields.narration: Facilitator → All: It is now 2:00. The problem has spread to multiple 911 trunks and 10-digit lines. The floor cannot maintain call integrity — 10 calls in queue, 2 with 90-second wait times. The Director has not yet declared Level 1, but the Technical Lead has manually isolated RCECD-POS09 and blocked its traffic. The TDoS-strict rule set is now active, but silent calls continue to flood the 10-digit lines. The shift must decide whether to go manual or wait for a recovery that may not come.
